spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §5.4 invariant 2 (subscription cannot complete before READY)
description: State violation: a Subscribe arriving before READY (here: in NEGOTIATING, before Negotiate) is answered with the fatal pair Error(402)+Close(402).
preconditions: Session authenticated; state NEGOTIATING (Negotiate not yet sent).
Isolated connection; request_id counter starts at 1.
assertions: The request decoded fine, so the Error echoes its request_id (1).
402 is fatal here (paired with Close): the non-fatal, connection-kept 402 exists only for a duplicate Subscribe in READY/PLAYING (spec §5.2 error classes).
Media subscription can never complete before pairing/auth/negotiation/configuration by state legality; violations produce a defined error, never a silent ignore (spec §5.4).
